title: The session ends with unfinished work and a background job still running
prompt: You're nearly out of context. Wrap up so another agent can continue tomorrow.
expected: writes a handoff record with goal, state, done and pending work, and the evidence labels
records the background job (command, PID and start time, log, how to stop it) without stopping it
offers a transfer of its claim and records the transfer token
checks the record against the repository before ending
